say:1:1430218201:1.text: That's a great idea! As long as they look the same, my lord won't find out!
say:1:1430218201:1.source_cn: 没错！只要再买一个一样的骨碟换上，主人就不会发现。
say:1:1430218201:1.male: That's a great idea! As long as they look the same, my lord won't find out!
say:1:1430218201:1.female: That's a great idea! As long as they look the same, my lord won't find out!

say:2:1430218202:1.text: He won't be able to banish me, and I'll continue living in the royal city.
say:2:1430218202:1.source_cn: 这样他就找不到驱逐我的理由，我就能继续待在王城里。
say:2:1430218202:1.male: He won't be able to banish me, and I'll continue living in the royal city.
say:2:1430218202:1.female: He won't be able to banish me, and I'll continue living in the royal city.

say:3:1430218203:1.text: Yes, I need to go find an identical one right now!
say:3:1430218203:1.source_cn: 对，只要换上新的，一切就不会有问题！
say:3:1430218203:1.male: Yes, I need to go find an identical one right now!
say:3:1430218203:1.female: Yes, I need to go find an identical one right now!
